key.name: magnification
key.description: 0.75 means the icon can reach 175% of normal size.

key.name: high-resolution-icons
key.description: Sharper enlarged icons, but some applications use different artwork in different icon sizes. When disabled, render a clone of the exact original Zorin Taskbar icon.

key.name: native-icon-apps
key.summary: Application IDs that should keep their original Zorin icon
key.description: Comma-separated desktop IDs. Only listed apps use the original icon rather than a different high-resolution PNG variant.

key.name: influence-radius
key.description: How far away the cursor influences adjacent icons.

key.name: bounce-enabled
key.summary: Bounce when a stopped application is launched from the taskbar
key.description: Do not bounce when switching to running applications.

key.name: bounce-height
key.summary: Distance of the launch bounce in logical pixels
key.description: The animated icon moves away from the taskbar edge.
